purpose: MiniCode font preview requested by user
interface_policy: Interface, sidebar, composer and settings use official Anthropic Sans. Latin conversation prose uses Anthropic Serif. Both use Noto Sans SC for Chinese. Code uses the existing monospace stack.
chinese_pairing: Anthropic Serif and Anthropic Sans do not include Chinese glyphs. Claude's official stacks use system CJK sans-serif faces; MiniCode bundles Noto Sans SC to keep Chinese consistent across platforms.
